scenes.say: What to expect in Qatar? The champion is already known, but plenty is still to be decided.
No sprint. Two practice sessions on Friday, third practice and qualifying on Saturday, the race on Sunday.
Fifty-seven laps of five point four one nine kilometres, about three hundred and nine kilometres in all.
The race lap record belongs to Norris: one twenty-two three eighty-four, set in twenty twenty-four.
Fast bends all lap. Hardest on tyres: the right-handers from Turn twelve to fourteen.
The main straight is over a kilometre long, and Turn one at the end of it is the best place to pass.
Pirelli brought its three hardest compounds, plus a limit: a set lasts at most twenty-seven laps.
Antonelli is champion with four hundred and two points. Verstappen has three hundred and four in second, Hamilton two sixty-seven.
Formula Two races at Lusail the same weekend.

title: Qatar: how the weekend works and what to watch
